tokenGate.title: Admin token required
tokenGate.description: Paste the admin token once. It is held only in this browser and is never bundled with the app.

confirm.title: Confirm booking approval
confirm.description: These are the exact rows that will be written to the ledger if you approve.
confirm.usdRateNote: The USD rate is read at write time and recorded as metadata only — it is never used for PnL.

reject.title: Reject booking proposal
reject.description: The discrepancy stays open and can be re-proposed later.
reject.reasonPlaceholder: Why is this proposal being rejected?

outcomes.ALREADY_DECIDED: This proposal has already been decided elsewhere. Nothing was written by this action.
outcomes.SUPERSEDED: The venue or ledger changed since this was prepared; nothing was written; a fresh proposal will appear.
outcomes.EXPIRED: This proposal expired before it could be approved. A fresh proposal may appear if the discrepancy is still open.
outcomes.DRY_RUN_REFUSED: This deployment is running in dry-run mode; booking approval and rejection are disabled.
